title: Tree and Table
statementMd:
Little Petya likes trees a lot. Recently his mother has presented him a tree with $2*n*$ nodes. Petya immediately decided to place this tree on a rectangular table consisting of 2 rows and $*n*$ columns so as to fulfill the following conditions:

1. Each cell of the table corresponds to exactly one tree node and vice versa, each tree node corresponds to exactly one table cell.
2. If two tree nodes are connected by an edge, then the corresponding cells have a common side.

Now Petya wonders how many ways are there to place his tree on the table. He calls two placements distinct if there is a tree node which corresponds to distinct table cells in these two placements. Since large numbers can scare Petya, print the answer modulo $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$). Next $(2*n* - 1)$ lines contain two integers each $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 2*n*; *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*})$ that determine the numbers of the vertices connected by the corresponding edge.

Consider the tree vertexes numbered by integers from $1$ to $2*n*$. It is guaranteed that the graph given in the input is a tree, that is, a connected acyclic undirected graph.

## Output

Print a single integer — the required number of ways to place the tree on the table modulo $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.

## Note

Note to the first sample (all 12 variants to place the tree on the table are given below):

```
1-3-2    2-3-1    5 4 6    6 4 5
| | |    | | |    | | |    | | |
5 4 6    6 4 5    1-3-2    2-3-1

4-3-2    2-3-4    5-1 6    6 1-5
  | |    | |        | |    | |
5-1 6    6 1-5    4-3-2    2-3-4

1-3-4    4-3-1    5 2-6    6-2 5
| |        | |    | |        | |
5 2-6    6-2 5    1-3-4    4-3-1
```
statementZhMd:
小 Petya 非常喜欢树。最近，他的母亲送给他一棵有 $2*n*$ 个节点的树。Petya 立即决定将这棵树放置在一个由 2 行和 $*n*$ 列组成的矩形表格中，并满足以下条件：

1. 表格中的每个单元格恰好对应一个树节点，反之，每个树节点也恰好对应一个表格单元格。
2. 如果两个树节点通过一条边相连，那么它们所对应的单元格必须有公共边。

现在 Petya 想知道，将这棵树放置在表格中有多少种方法。如果在两种放置方式中，存在某个树节点对应的表格单元格不同，那么他认为这两种放置方式不同。由于较大的数字可能会吓到 Petya，请输出答案对 $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）。接下来的 $(2*n* - 1)$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ 2*n*; *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示相应边所连接的顶点编号。

树的顶点编号为从 1 到 $2*n*$ 的整数。保证输入中的图是一棵树，即一个连通且无环的无向图。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即将树放置在表格中的方法数对 $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

第一个样例的说明（下面给出了将树放置在表格中的全部 12 种方式）：

```
1-3-2    2-3-1    5 4 6    6 4 5
| | |    | | |    | | |    | | |
5 4 6    6 4 5    1-3-2    2-3-1

4-3-2    2-3-4    5-1 6    6 1-5
  | |    | |        | |    | |
5-1 6    6 1-5    4-3-2    2-3-4

1-3-4    4-3-1    5 2-6    6-2 5
| |        | |    | |        | |
5 2-6    6-2 5    1-3-4    4-3-1
```
